name: elevenlabs-stt
description: Transcribe audio with ElevenLabs Scribe and write word-level timings to JSON.
long_description: Adds one tool, transcribe_audio, for the social-content folder. It reads an audio or video file from your working folder, sends it to ElevenLabs Scribe, and writes word-level timings to JSON next to it. Word boundaries from Scribe are measured rather than inferred, so cuts land cleaner than they do with the local model.

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description: Transcribe an audio or video file and write word-level timings to JSON.

api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
api_key.description: From your profile menu at elevenlabs.io. The free tier covers about 30 minutes of audio a month.

working_folder.title: Working folder
working_folder.description: The social-content folder on your Desktop. Cowork sees it at a different path than your Mac does, so the extension needs to know where it really lives.

model_id.title: Scribe model
model_id.description: Leave as is unless ElevenLabs changes model names.
